 Sharks at Bruins projected lineups
 By 
 NHL.com 
 @NHLMedia 
 October 24, 2026 
 Link copied 
 SHARKS (6-4-1) at BRUINS (8-2-1) 
 7 p.m. NBCSCA, NESN 
 Sharks projected lineup 
 Collin Graf -- Macklin Celebrini -- Will Smith
 Ivar Stenberg -- Michael Misa -- Kiefer Sherwood
 Mason Marchment -- Ty Dellandrea -- Tyler Toffoli
 Barclay Goodrow -- Zack Ostapchuk -- Adam Gaudette
 Darnell Nurse -- Michael Kesselring
 Sam Dickinson -- Jacob Trouba
 Dmitry Orlov -- Nolan Allan
 Alex Nedeljkovic
 Yaroslav Askarov
 Scratched: Luca Cagnoni 
 Injured: Alexander Wennberg (upper body), Igor Chernyshov (upper body) 
 Bruins projected lineup 
 JJ Peterka -- Pavel Zacha -- David Pastrnak
 Marat Khusnutdinov -- Fraser Minten -- Morgan Geekie
 Casey Mittelstadt -- Elias Lindholm -- James Hagens
 Tanner Jeannot -- Matthew Poitras -- Mark Kastelic
 Hampus Lindholm -- Charlie McAvoy
 Nikita Zadorov -- Will Borgen
 Frederic Brunet -- Mason Lohrei
 Jeremy Swayman
 Michael DiPietro
 Scratched: Jonathan Aspirot, Sean Kuraly, Connor Clifton 
 Injured: None 
 Status report 
 Chernyshov returned to San Jose and the forward is week to week after leaving in the first period of a 6-2 win at the Ottawa Senators on Thursday when he blocked a slap shot off his left arm by Senators defenseman Nikolas Mantinpalo. ... Gaudette will make his season debut on the fourth line with Goodrow and Ostapchuk. ... Graf returns to the top line and will play alongside Celebrini and Smith. ... Nedeljkovic will start. ... The Bruins will dress the same 18 skaters they used in a 6-0 win against the Nashville Predators on Thursday.
